elements.evidence: Section 12.4 prohibits Customer, as one of “Neither party,” from directly soliciting specified personnel of Vendor.
Section 12.4 applies equally to “Neither party” regarding personnel of the other party.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: It is limited to personnel “directly involved in performing or receiving the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: It lasts “for twelve months following the end of that individual's involvement in the Services.”

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The restriction expressly excludes “general advertisements” and other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party’s personnel.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The restriction expressly does not apply “to unsolicited approaches by an individual.”

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative restriction prohibits only direct solicitation, not hiring, and expressly permits hiring or engaging people responding to general recruitment or approaching unsolicited; Section 12.3 also confirms no no-hire commitment.
